chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Abu Ayyub from Muhammad ibn Muslim
He said: I looked at a sheet that Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) was reading from, and I read in it written: 'The son of the brother and the grandfather, the wealth is equal between them two.'
He said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): Indeed, those among us do not rule with this ruling; they do not give the son of the brother anything along with the grandfather.
So Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'It is dictated by the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and the handwriting of Ali (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.ابْنُ الْأَخِ: son of the brother (paternal uncle's son)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of the grandfather and the son of the brother according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights a specific inheritance ruling where the grandfather and the son of the brother share equally, contrasting with the view of many jurists who exclude the latter in the presence of the former. Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) validates this by attributing the text to the dictation of the Prophet and the handwriting of Imam Ali, thereby establishing its authority within Shia jurisprudence. This underscores the significance of *al-kutub al-arba'a* and the direct transmission of legal precedents from the Ahl al-Bayt.
